assumptions.obligation: The AXI Manager drives AWVALID, WVALID and ARVALID low while i_rst_n_axi is active (AXI4 Manager reset rule, with reset of the Manager coordinated by the SoC).
Once AWVALID is high it stays high, and AWID/AWADDR/AWLEN/AWSIZE/AWBURST/AWCACHE/AWPROT stay stable, until AWREADY is high (AXI4 VALID/READY handshake).
Once WVALID is high it stays high, and WDATA/WSTRB/WLAST stay stable, until WREADY is high; W may be presented before AW.
Once ARVALID is high it stays high, and ARID/ARADDR/ARLEN/ARSIZE/ARBURST/ARCACHE/ARPROT stay stable, until ARREADY is high.

The AXI Manager asserts WLAST exactly on W beat AWLEN+1 of the corresponding accepted write. Beats sent before AW are counted. Constrained only while an accepted AW has outstanding W data and the count has not overshot.

notes: Not constrained, on purpose: (1) unsupported AxSIZE, reserved AxBURST, AxCACHE other than 0000/0001, illegal burst lengths and 4-KiB-crossing bursts. The bridge must detect and reject these (AB-3-09, AB-9-02, AB-9-06, AB-9-08, AB-9-09), so they stay legal stimulus. (2) The APB inputs PREADY, PSLVERR and PRDATA are free. PREADY may stay low forever (AB-3-40, AB-10.3-02) and PSLVERR=1 is a legal error response (AB-3-41). The default-Completer obligation (AB-3-38, AB-20-07) is liveness and can't be written as an immediate assumption. (3) RREADY and BREADY back-pressure is free (AB-5.1-03, AB-15.2-02). (4) WSTRB lane legality versus address/size, and WRAP start-address alignment, are AXI4 Manager rules the spec doesn't spell out (AB-20-05 names WSTRB but gives no checkable rule). They are left out; this can only cause spurious failures, never hide a bug. Add them only if a counterexample relies on them. (5) The reset is already assumed active in the initial state. Because reset is synchronous, nothing else is needed for AB-7.3-02 or AB-3-26. (6) The ENV-05 tracker keeps the first accepted AW if a second AW handshake overlaps it, and leaves WLAST free if the bridge accepts W beats beyond the declared count. This keeps the assumptions satisfiable when the bridge misbehaves, so they can't hide a violation of AB-3-02 or AB-5.3-04. Not yet run through Yosys or a solver.
